pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Keres Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Nbd2-f1-g3/e3 with a bare e3 and called d5 a push that opens the centre; plan 2 offered a ...f5 break and the a5-knight to b7; plan 3 was vague. Rewrote plans 1-3 around ...cxd4, ...Nc6, ...Bf6 and Nbd2-b3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 10...Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with the knight on b1 and the d-pawn on d2; plan 2 had ...c5 hit a d4-pawn that is not there yet; plan 4 described a minority attack. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 around ...c5 and ...Nc4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 10...c6
pages.notes: Overview had ...c6 bolstering a d5-pawn that does not exist; plan 3 gave Nbd2 with the d-pawn on d2 and a bare e3; plan 4 sent the knight to c6, where Black's pawn now stands. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 3, 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 11.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Nf3-f1-g3-f5, a route the f3-knight cannot take; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 11.d4 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3-f5 with the knight still on b1; plan 3 used a bare d2-f1-e3 route; plan 4 sent the a5-knight to b7, where the bishop stands. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4 (first plan 3 rewrite rejected as unconfirmed: Nc3 after ...cxd4; replaced with Nbd2 guarding e4 and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 11.d4 cxd4
pages.notes: Overview said White uses the d-file, which stays closed with pawns on d4 and d6; plan 1 gave Nf3-f1-g3; plan 2 sent the knight to b7 and the bishop to b7 together and put the rooks on a closed e-file. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, Keres, 11.Nbd2 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a bare Nf1-g3/e3 tour; plan 4 described a minority attack. Rewrote both around cxd4, Nb3, ...a5-a4 and ...Nb6/...Nf6. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Chigorin Defense
pages.notes: Overview said 9...Na5 forces the bishop to a2 (it goes to c2); plan 1 called d4 a break that opens the centre; plan 3 gave Nf1-g3 and an f4 push with the knight on b1; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 3, 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Chigorin Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Nf3-f1-g3; plan 2 met d5 with ...cxd4, which d5 rules out. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Chigorin, 11.d4 Qc7 12.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the c2-bishop to g2 via a fianchetto; plan 2 called ...cxd4 a way to maintain the tension; plan 4 offered a ...d5 break. Rewrote plans 2-4 around ...cxd4 Nc6 Nb3 Be3 and ...Bd7/...Rac8. British spelling.
